answers.question: A follow-up call to the staff task queue that gets no answer is not retried. Shortest path: the refund fails, the agent calls to hand the case to staff, the call gets no answer, and the customer has to be told something. What does the agent tell the customer then?
answers.recommended: It tells the customer what happened to the order and the refund, that it could not reach store staff, and asks them to contact the store.
answers.reply: > On timeout, retry once; if it times out again, tell the customer to contact Harbor Goods support.

answers.question: Nothing in the inputs bounds how many orders a customer may cancel in one conversation. What ends it?
answers.recommended: The agent works on one order at a time; a request to cancel another order gets its own proposal and its own yes. It ends when the customer makes no further request; each order can be cancelled only once, so the customer's open orders bound it.

answers.question: Your order system has no docs. In common order systems a lookup call can get no answer. When the order lookup gets no answer at the start, what does the agent do? Claims put to the owner: C-07.
answers.recommended: It makes no retry, tells the customer it cannot look up their orders right now, and changes nothing.
answers.reply: > Reads may be retried on timeout without limit; only commit calls are bounded.

answers.question: After a refund call with no answer, the agent retries once, then looks the order up again and reports what it finds. Shortest path: the cancel succeeds, both refund calls get no answer, and the new lookup shows no refund, a failed refund, or gets no answer itself. What does the agent do in each case?
answers.recommended: When the new lookup shows no refund or a failed refund, the agent tells the customer the order is cancelled and the refund was not issued, and hands the case to staff as "refund not issued". When the new lookup gets no answer, it tells the customer the order is cancelled and it is not known whether the refund was issued, and hands the case to staff as "refund status unknown".
answers.reply:
> 3. Cancel succeeded, refund call timed out — state unknown; agent retries once, then re-reads the order and refund records and reports what it finds.
> Final message must match the final refund status.
> For case 3, after the retry the agent re-reads the refund record: pending or issued, report that status; failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet; re-read fails, say status unknown and hand off.
